t: You're at the site of St Mary Magdalen Old Fish Street, on the corner of Old Fish Street and Old Change. The land is now covered by post-war development. A church stood here from the twelfth century, until the Great Fire of 1666 destroyed it. It was rebuilt by the office of Sir Christopher Wren, the architect given charge of rebuilding fifty-two City churches. A fire in a neighbouring warehouse damaged the roof in 1886, and the church was never repaired. It was demolished in 1893. George Moult, who died in 1727, was buried here.
